slug: 2025-02-18 Senegal targets 3M ECOWAS biometric ID holders for voter registration

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports a biometric voter-registration exercise began on 1 February 2025, expected to enrol nearly 3 million holders of the ECOWAS biometric ID card absent from the electoral database, running to 31 July 2025.
Biometric Update reports the ECOWAS biometric ID card is now the sole accepted proof of identity for voter registration in Senegal, replacing birth-certificate extracts.
